decision.title: xsl:evaluate (packet )
decision.summary: xsl:evaluate is a static call whose resumable body compiles the target with sxml_xpath_compile and runs it as a on the same machine, with stylesheet functions passed as function items.

body.p: , after , , , , , . Replaces 's one place for dynamic evaluation (the XTDE3175 raise in src/xslt_lower_control.c): xsl:evaluate is available, so XTDE3175 is never raised and the xsl:fallback children are not evaluated.

item.p: One mechanism (): the instruction is a STATIC_CALL of an internal row (src/xslt_evaluate.c) whose resumable body compiles the target expression with sxml_xpath_compile and asks the machine for a unit evaluation (EVALUATE_UNIT, ), as fn:load-xquery-module does; the second step gives its value. A nested xsl:evaluate (in a stylesheet function the target calls) is one more unit evaluation on the same machine: no C recursion ().

Static context (10.5.1), read lexically from the call's module (the xsl:evaluate element's, ): its static namespaces (prefix 0 is its xpath-default-namespace), or the in-scope namespaces of the namespace-context node (XTTE3170 unless one node; xml and undeclarations dropped); base-uri resolved against the instruction's base URI; its collations, default collation and decimal formats; its in-scope schemas only with schema-aware="yes"; the parameters as external variables of type item()*, xsl:with-param (lowered as for xsl:call-template) under with-params (XTTE3165 unless one map with xs:QName keys). trusted="no", the default, makes the unit untrusted (sxml_ir_unit_set_untrusted, FODC0016 for resources). schema-aware and trusted: XTSE0020 for a fixed non-boolean word, XTDE0030 for a computed one.

Functions (10.5.1): the F&O library, then the stylesheet functions whose visibility is public or final, then fn:current (XSLT 4.0 allows it: the current item is the target's context item); no other XSLT-defined function. The stylesheet functions belong to the stylesheet's unit, so the lowering passes them as function items (a map from name to the references of its arities, bound through the instruction's function table), and the target's function table binds them with a new function entry kind, FUNCTION_ITEM (src/function_library_internal.h): a call lowers to a DYNAMIC_CALL of the item as a constant, a named reference to the item. Keyword arguments to them are not supported (the entry has no parameter names).

Dynamic context (10.5.2): the context-item value is the context item; an empty one, or none, is no context (XPDY0002, as evaluate-025 expects); more than one item is XTTE3210, XSLT 3.0's rule, which evaluate-026 and error-3210a expect (a deviation from the 4.0 draft, which makes the value the context value). Dynamic errors keep their codes; a static error of the target is XTDE3160 with the static error's description.

Counts (release driver, whole XT40 against 9856281, case by case): 8,899 to 8,973 passed, 0 errors, no case lost; evaluate 73 of 83 (9 of them with another error code), 91 % of the 80 run, 88 % of the 83; error-3175a and system-property-014b need the feature absent and are not run any more. The 90 % gate of 7.3 is not met yet: 3 cases wait for html-doc and parse-html (7.10), 2 for trust checks in json-doc and unparsed-text-available, 1 needs a UCA collation strength (7.15), 1 (evaluate-008a) expects XPST0017 for a call use-when removes.

Not done: keyword arguments to stylesheet functions; json-doc and unparsed-text-available do not check trust yet (evaluate-454/455, src/function_library_resource.c was another packet's file); html-doc and parse-html wait for 7.10.
